_⚠️ Potential issue_ | _🔴 Critical_

**Guard the index before dereferencing `items[idx]`.**

`idx` can equal `len(items)` after the loop, so the last iteration raises
IndexError instead of returning the tail element.

<details>
<summary>📝 Committable suggestion</summary>

> ℹ️ **Note**
> Carefully review the code before committing.

```suggestion
    if idx < len(items):
        return items[idx]
```

</details>
